_description: CLOSURE source of truth: the transport-once Layer-A artifacts the air-gap deployment requires.
Two consumers: (1) `zarf:package` CI-gates that the built bundle contains every declared artifact
and stays under the size budget; (2) `converge` preflight (T0) verifies the air-gap environment has
them loaded BEFORE acting, failing loud + exact if not.
CONSERVATION: nothing listed here may be deleted by any deploy/converge step. Loss of a Layer-A
artifact = offline re-inspect + re-transport (the crictl-rmi-prune and deleted-StorageClass outages).

package.name: cybersec-dask
package._note: GitHub release-asset hard limit is 2 GiB (2147483648). Warn at ~1.75 GiB so we slim before hitting it.

_note: Layer-A images that MUST live in the NODE's containerd BEFORE the Zarf internal registry exists,
because the default-StorageClass provisioner runs pre-registry (chicken-and-egg: it can't be pulled
from a registry that the provisioner is needed to stand up). These are pre-loaded at node setup
(RKE2 bundled-images dir or `ctr -n k8s.io images import`) and MUST NEVER be pruned. This is the
exact gap the `crictl rmi --prune` disaster exposed.

package_images._note: Layer-A images carried INSIDE the Zarf package and pushed to the internal registry during deploy. The CI gate verifies the built .tar.zst declares all of these (Zarf rewrites localhost:5555 refs to the internal registry on deploy).

images.role: Dask + Panel/HoloViews/Datashader + cybersec app (the ~2 GB image)

binaries._note: Carried alongside the package for fully-offline init; pinned to avoid archive-format skew.

node_requirements._note: Layer-A node-level invariants verified by converge T0. The engine DETECTS + HINTS; the real fix lives in the RKE2 config templates (infra/aws/ansible/roles/rke2-*/templates) and node setup. converge never changes kubelet args itself.
node_requirements.kubelet_eviction: lenient + persistent: eviction-hard=imagefs.available<2%,nodefs.available<2%,nodefs.inodesFree<2%,memory.available<100Mi — so disk pressure cannot flap mid-deploy and survives rke2 restarts
node_requirements.containerd_disk: registry + image layers fit on the node's data/root volume; size accordingly per topology profile
